messages:
maria: Heads up — PR #8623 turned the hetero-gpu-warmup job red on shard 3. Logs show memory pressure + nvlink errors, then a kernel reset.
kai: saw that, zapped the raw logs. nv-hostengine reported 'nvlink: peer reset' around the same time.
ci-bot: build failed — job=hetero-gpu-warmup shard=3 image=redwood/ci:gpu-2025-02 driver=535.86 test=warmup_smoke
sam: can you paste the minimal failing stack/log lines? also which node?
maria: node=dgx-12-07, short tail:
```
[W] nvidia: nvlink tx timeout
E] cuda: kernel_launch failed: unspecified launch error
E] gpu: oom-ish: attempted alloc 1.2G but available 512M
I] nv-hostengine: peer reset detected
```
maria: this looks like memory pressure cascading into a kernel reset, not a pure driver mismatch.
devon: intermittent on hetero nodes lately — we saw similar on multi-job packing. Was this a parallel shard run or single job?
ci-bot: test metadata: concurrency=4 packing=hetero multi_job=true
kai: ok, likely multi-job interference. Quick triage plan: 1) rerun the shard pinned to a single job (no packing) 2) rerun using driver 535.65 (previous stable) 3) collect nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY and nvlink stats before/after
maria: can one of you trigger a targeted rerun? I'll attach a debug script that dumps /var/log/nvidia and runs nvidia-smi loop.
sam: triggering now: `ci rerun --job hetero-gpu-warmup --shard 3 --env PACKING=0 --note "debug-memory-pressure"`
ci-bot: rerun queued — new-job-id=hdrun-1758010301
maria: also request a canary on the same image but with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0` pinned to avoid inter-GPU traffic, command below:
```
ci run-canary --node dgx-12-07 --image redwood/ci:gpu-2025-02 --env "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0" --collect "nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY; nvlink --status"
```
devon: if the single-job run passes and canary passes, that's strong signal multi-job packing/ nvlink contention. If they fail, we try driver rollback.
kai: FYI I'm grabbing a copy of the kernel ring buffer in case it's a kernel-level crash: `dmesg -T | tail -n 200 > /tmp/dmesg-${JOB}.log`
maria: perfect. tagging infra: @sam @kai please keep this thread updated. If rerun is green, we'll close and add a packing safety flag in CI config.
sam: update 1758010400 — rerun started on dgx-12-07, enabling debug-dump.
ci-bot: rerun started — job=hdrun-1758010301 state=running
maria: thanks all. if rerun still flakes we should schedule a bisect across driver 535.86 <-> 535.65 next week; for now let's focus on repro with packing=0 and single-device canary.
devon: noted, will add bisect ticket if needed. :thumbsup:
